request: Rename Todo.done to Todo.completed everywhere, and make list hide completed todos by default (includeDone: true shows them). --single

requests.title: commands > lists, optionally hiding done items
requests.reason: The request changes list's default to hide completed todos. The old assertion that list(todos) shows both items described the old default, so it now expects only the open item. I added an includeDone: true assertion for showing all items and kept the includeDone: false case.
